_about: Which quotes have been checked against their source, and how often each kind of source must be re-checked. 'stable' sources (old forum posts, YouTube videos, archived pages, legislation, screenshots) are checked once and then only when a quote changes or is added; 'slow' sources are re-checked after recheck_days; 'live' sources (Dino Den's site and API, Patreon, trackers) are re-checked in every full review. The first matching rule wins. Record checks with: python3 tools/check.py --verified SOURCE "how".

stability.why: published screenshots do not change; the OCR check compares their quotes on every run
old forum posts; authors and post dates are fixed. Re-check a quote only if it is new or changed
history frozen since the counts were made private on 29 Mar 2026
official or reference pages that change rarely
the operator's live site, API and Patreon page, and a live tracker
quotes with no outside link in their section: the source can't be classed from a link, so they are re-checked every review unless the section is listed under 'sections' as stable
